t: This is Gloucester Walk, a street in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. Nothing grand is recorded about the street itself, so it's best taken as a quiet piece of residential London. What the record does tell us is that Sheila Anne Lowther, born in 1943, lived here. That connection is the thread that puts this street on the map of people's lives, even though the details of her story aren't given in the material I have.
